rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: No completed felling overlaps the 0.58 ha polygon (0%).
No Artportalen records inside or within 250 m of the polygon, and near-site effort there is zero records against a county median of 3 within 250 m.

Four eligible species (VU, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) are recorded between 311 and 487 m: Alectoria sarmentosa 311 m, Goodyera repens 356 m, Antrodiella citrinella 456 m, Phellopilus nigrolimitatus 487 m, all 2025 with uncertainty of 25 m or less. The rubric hint, which counts 6 eligible species in the 1000 m ring, is MEDIUM.
Five site-bound forest NT species are recorded at 433-448 m, outside the 250 m ring, so they do not trigger the NT rule.
Overall recording effort is adequate (335 records, 90th percentile), but the records are not near the polygon.

uncertainties: Eligible records are 311 m or more from the polygon; whether similar habitat extends into the 0.58 ha polygon is unknown.
Zero near-site records could reflect recording coverage as well as the species present. The records cluster at 311-490 m, perhaps from a single survey visit (3 observation days in the 500 m ring).
The 1000 m ring (6 eligible species) was not queried separately; the count comes from the rubric hint.
not_established: That any red-listed species occurs on the polygon.
That absence of records within 250 m means absence of species.
Legal protection, or the legality or ecological effect of the felling.
next_action: Human reviewer should compare the polygon's stand with the surrounding area where the 2025 VU and NT records were made, and decide whether a field check is needed before felling begins.
